title: Roast grapes and pears with yoghurt

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Grapes, pears, honey, oil, walnuts, Greek yoghurt, cinnamon and thyme are all plain kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray and a knife, and the technique is simple roasting.

works.reason: 500g grapes and two pears roasted for 15 minutes at 200°C will blister and soften, which is right for four snack bowls over 400g yoghurt.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes covers stripping the grapes and chunking two pears, and the 15-minute roast matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm roast grapes are the centre of this mid-October afternoon snack.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fruit, yoghurt and walnuts with only a tablespoon of honey make a satisfying, wholesome snack.
